submittedParameters.prompt:
Make one precise final crop-safety refinement to Image 1, the wordless autumn-equinox banner. Keep the image extremely close to Image 1 in all other respects. Image 2 is the approved Mid-Autumn identity/painted-style reference; Image 3 is the approved mail UI art-finish reference only. Do not copy text, UI, frames, moon, rabbit or lanterns from those references.

Keep the native 2098x749 canvas, exact 2.8:1 full-bleed continuous landscape, quiet open jade lake and soft distant mountains throughout the left 45%, right-hand autumn persimmon branches, rice terraces and turquoise Daoist mountains. Preserve the bright restrained hand-painted finish and all face, hand, garment and gourd details.

Only correct the right-side character group's lower crop safety. At present the bottoms of the shoes are too near y=86% of image height. Shrink the BOY + HELD RICE + HIP GOURD + BASKET grouping another 10% and move it slightly upward on the bank. The bottom of BOTH boot soles must now sit at y=78% to y=80% of the full canvas height, leaving at least 20% image height of beautifully painted foreground path and grass below the feet. Head, hair, rice tips, hands, basket and feet must all remain comfortably inside y=15% to y=85%. Keep the boy in the right third, make feet firmly contact the natural sloping stone path, with coherent shadows and no hovering. Two intact shoes, unchanged cheerful face and gold headband, unchanged natural small hands clasping the rice stems. Keep the woven basket grounded beside him. Do not enlarge the character again and do not crop the entire picture.

No text, calligraphy, letters, numbers, visible watermark, UI controls, border or panel. No anatomy changes, no extra fingers or duplicate limbs, no overexposure. Deliver the final single refined autumn-equinox illustration.

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: standalone wordless AUTUMN EQUINOX 秋分 game-mail banner for 五行奇谈.

Input Image 1 = approved event-midautumn.png banner. This is the primary reference for the detailed hand-painted Daoist Q-chibi brushwork, boy identity, material rendering and right-side composition. Transform its entire seasonal setting into autumn equinox daytime.
Input Image 2 = approved 01-mail-event.png. Supporting reference only for the confirmed refined jade, ivory and warm-gold art finish and softly rounded hand-painted volumes. Do not reproduce any UI controls, frames or writing from Image 2.

Keep exactly Image 1's round-faced little boy identity: large warm brown eyes, short spiky dark-brown hair, gold headband, ivory-and-jade robes, golden Taiji gourd. The boy has a large head, short rounded torso and short limbs. Preserve refined hand-painted contours and rich material shading rather than glossy plastic.

A clear balanced autumn daytime scene with mellow golden rice terraces beside a placid jade-green lake, distant rounded jade-roof Daoist temples and layered turquoise mountains. On the right third the same cheerful little boy holds a neatly tied small sheaf of ripe rice above a woven harvest basket. Both small hands wrap naturally around the tied stems in a simple readable grasp; anatomically coherent hands with no duplicate fingers. His golden Taiji gourd hangs securely at the outer hip, visibly separate from his forearms. Full body, two distinct booted feet grounded on the bank, no cropped feet. Sparse persimmon fruit and russet leaves on far-right branches. Warm soft harvest light, rich midtones, clean cream clothing with visible folds and shading, rounded silhouettes, restrained gold. Autumn equinox harvest landscape, no Mid-Autumn night or Double Ninth chrysanthemums.

Native wide 2.8:1 banner, target 2098x749 at best supported native resolution. Full-bleed single scene, no panels. Left 45 percent simple low-contrast lake and distant fields for separately drawn native title. Boy and key harvest action on right third; keep all essential anatomy and harvest props within central 70 percent of image height to tolerate shallow mail-banner cropping. Calm clear sky and subtle water reflections; foreground detail focused on right.

No text, letters, calligraphy, numerals, UI, logo, visible watermark or border. No full moon, rabbits, mooncakes, lanterns, chrysanthemums, snow, plastic toy rendering or photorealism. No overexposure, blown-out clothing or excessive bloom. Preserve the refined brushwork and visual completion of the two attached approved references. Create only this one autumn-equinox illustration.

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit Image 1, the current autumn-equinox banner. Make only a layout and background-quietness refinement while preserving its exact identity, excellent harvest scene, hand-painted brushwork, warm restrained daytime lighting, colors, materials, face, clothes, hands and grasp.

Input Image 1: edit target, the newly generated autumn equinox illustration.
Input Image 2: approved Mid-Autumn banner, identity and detailed painted style reference only; do not copy moon, rabbit, lantern, flowers or night lighting.
Input Image 3: approved mail UI, supporting reference only for refined art finish; do not copy any UI or writing.

Keep one continuous full-bleed 2098x749 native wide 2.8:1 autumn equinox illustration.
REQUIRED COMPOSITION CORRECTION 1: The LEFT 45 PERCENT must now be quiet, low-contrast open jade lake, sky, a narrow distant band of golden rice fields and softly receding turquoise mountain silhouettes. Remove the intrusive close-up rice stalks, wooden fence posts, large crisp temples, wheel and bridge within the left 45 percent. Reduce the contrast and number of background details on that left area substantially, blending naturally into the detailed right half. Do not add a blank rectangular panel, frame, gradient overlay or vignette. Keep beautiful painted scenery, but calm enough for large native overlay text in the left middle.
REQUIRED COMPOSITION CORRECTION 2: Scale the right-side BOY + HELD RICE SHEAF + HARVEST BASKET group down to about 80% of its current size and reposition so all essential anatomy and props fit between y=16% and y=84% of the image height. Top of hair at or below y=16%, bottom of both boots at or above y=84%. Keep group in the right third, with feet physically grounded on a naturally raised stone bank, correct contact shadows. Two full distinct shoes, complete hair/headband and held rice tips must be visible and fit this safe area. Preserve the exact round face and the existing natural two-handed grasp around the tied rice stems. Keep the golden Taiji gourd attached at the outer hip, separate from forearms, and the woven harvest basket grounded beside him.
Preserve the autumn persimmon tree with sparse orange fruits and russet leaves on far right, golden terraces behind the right-side scene, jade-roof Daoist temples and layered mountains to the center-right. Daytime harvest atmosphere, clean cream clothes with folds, no blown highlights.
No text, letters, calligraphy, numbers, logo, visible watermark, UI, frame, border, collage or split panels. No full moon, rabbits, mooncakes, hanging lanterns, chrysanthemums or snow. Do not change the boy's anatomy or expression. Do not turn the image into a flat vector or plastic 3D render.

generationHistory.visualReview: 最终落盘图已由主代理与独立复查代理实际查看：人物头顶约27%、鞋底约78%高度，完整人物、手持稻束和竹篮在15%-85%中央安全区内；左45%为低对比天空、远山、湖面，留白安静。面部、抓握接触及双脚无明显缺陷，无可见文字、水印、界面框或过曝。手指部分遮挡，不能逐手独立确认完整五指。

export.note: 工具原生2098×749，逐字节复制，无缩放、裁切、重采样或像素后处理。

visualReview.method: 两位检查者均使用 view_image 实际查看最终PNG，并对照两张已批准参考。

checks.theme: 成熟金稻穗、竹篮、金色田畦、柿枝与秋叶体现秋分丰收；白天清朗湖山；不含中秋月兔饼或重阳菊花。
checks.style: 延续圆脸棕眼金发带道童、玉绿米白金边衣装与暖金太极葫芦；精细手绘体积、温润中间调。
checks.face: 五官完整、表情自然，无明显变形。
checks.hands: 两手可辨且自然合握稻秆，无明显多余手指；部分手指被稻束及手掌遮挡，完整每手五指数目不可独立确认。
checks.feet: 两只靴子完整、各自着地，鞋底下方留足前景。
checks.contact: 稻穗在手内、竹篮有地面承托、葫芦挂于外侧腰部，未见明显穿插或漂浮。
checks.negativeSpace: 左45%以低对比湖面、天空及远山为主，无人物或主要近景道具，适合排字；不是空白面板。
checks.cropSafety: 主角头顶约27%、鞋底约78%高度；完整人物、稻束与竹篮均位于中央15%-85%高度区域。人工目测，未宣称像素级物体分割。
checks.text: 未发现可见文字、字母、数字、logo、水印、UI框或拼图分隔。
checks.exposure: 白衣保留皱褶与阴影，金属中间调清楚，无明显过曝。

limits: 手指存在自然遮挡，无法逐根完整计数。
本次只验收秋分独立横幅，不代表全库、浏览器或Unity接入验收。
